title: Inspect and extend: Present a complete transparent health-demo journey
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/exposure.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve screen-to-model integration, clear-state wording, limitations, and demo script.
problem: Demonstrate status, simulated check, symptom score, and saved history as one journey. Each screen must explain whether a value is simulated and what it cannot tell the user. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/exposure.ts` and the related project files: App.tsx; src/screens/StatusScreen.tsx; src/screens/SymptomsScreen.tsx; src/exposure.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to screen-to-model integration, clear-state wording, limitations, and demo script.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Never encourage a learner to make health decisions from the demo output.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Demonstrate status, simulated check, symptom score, and saved history as one journey. Each screen must explain whether a value is simulated and what it cannot tell the user.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/exposure.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
